eval_pandas_expression: eval a Python expression string using pandas parser and numexpr engine
eval_expression_with_engine: eval an expression string using the python engine instead of numexpr
eval_expression_with_target: eval an expression and assign the result to a column in a target DataFrame
eval_multiline_expressions: eval multiple assignment expressions across lines on a target DataFrame
check_valid_engine: check that a given engine string is valid and available for pandas eval
